players.product: data-center electrical contracting (The Superior Group), data-center fiber/interconnection buildout and power-delivery infrastructure

quarterly_data.signal: MasTec 10-K: 2025 segment revenue was Communications $3,339.1 million (+32.3%), Clean Energy and Infrastructure $4,699.6 million (+14.8%), Power Delivery $4,176.1 million (+15.6%) and Pipeline Infrastructure $2,137.8 million (+0.2%), with segment EBITDA of $1,345.6 million. Estimated 18-month backlog was $18,963 million at December 31, 2025 (Communications $5,483 million, Clean Energy and Infrastructure $6,506 million, Power Delivery $5,579 million, Pipeline Infrastructure $1,395 million), about 74% expected to be realized in 2026 and 47% under master service or other service agreements. MasTec had approximately 1,800 customers in 2025; its top ten customers were 34% of revenue and governmental entities about 13%. 2025 capital expenditures were approximately $260 million, and it estimates approximately $270 million in 2026.
